description: A reproducible neuroimaging desktop with JupyterLab and scientific applications delivered through Neurodesk's CVMFS software catalog.
notes: Requires privileged containers for CVMFS and nested Apptainer execution. The desktop user has passwordless sudo. Deploy on agents designated for trusted scientific workloads. Enable persistent profiles at /home/kasm-user to retain user files. Software downloads require outbound network access. Proposed scope: Kasm 1.19.x on amd64; full Kasm platform validation is pending. GPU support is not validated.
